source.documentName: CISCE ICSE Regulations and Syllabuses - Science (Physics Code 52, Chemistry Code 53, Biology Code 54)

chapters.title: Measurements and Experimentation
chapters.description: International System of Units (SI), Vernier Callipers, Micrometer Screw Gauge, and the Simple Pendulum.

levels.title: Units & Vernier Callipers
levels.description: Fundamental and derived SI units, least count concept, and measuring with Vernier Callipers.

levels.title: Micrometer Screw Gauge
levels.description: Pitch, least count of screw gauge, zero errors and measuring thin wires or sheets.

levels.title: The Simple Pendulum
levels.description: Time period, effective length, acceleration due to gravity, and factors affecting time period.
subtopics: Definition of oscillation, amplitude, frequency, time period

levels.title: Chapter 1 Review & Experimental Physics
levels.description: Review of experimental measurements, instruments, and simple pendulum calculations.

chapters.title: Motion in One Dimension
chapters.description: Scalars and vectors, distance, displacement, speed, velocity, acceleration, and equations of motion.

levels.title: Distance, Displacement & Velocity
levels.description: Distinguishing scalar from vector quantities, average speed and instantaneous velocity.

levels.title: Acceleration & Graphs of Motion
levels.description: Uniform and non-uniform acceleration, displacement-time and velocity-time graphs.
subtopics: Slope of s-t and v-t graphs
Area under v-t graph equals displacement

levels.title: Equations of Uniformly Accelerated Motion
levels.description: Derivation and numerical application of v = u + at, s = ut + 0.5at^2, and v^2 = u^2 + 2as.

levels.title: Chapter 2 Review & Kinematics Mastery
levels.description: Comprehensive motion problem solving and graphical analysis.

chapters.title: Laws of Motion & Gravitation
chapters.description: Contact and non-contact forces, Newton's three laws of motion, linear momentum, inertia, and universal gravitation.

levels.title: Newton's First Law & Inertia
levels.description: Force definition, qualitative concept of inertia of rest, motion, and direction.

levels.title: Newton's Second Law & Momentum
levels.description: Linear momentum p = mv, rate of change of momentum, and F = ma derivation.

levels.title: Newton's Third Law & Universal Gravitation
levels.description: Action and reaction forces, Universal law of gravitation F = G*m1*m2/r^2, and g vs G.
subtopics: Acceleration due to gravity and weight

levels.title: Chapter 3 Review & Dynamics Challenge
levels.description: Review of forces, momentum conservation, and gravitational calculations.

chapters.title: Matter and Its Composition
chapters.description: Particulate nature of matter, states of matter, kinetic molecular theory, physical vs chemical changes, and mixtures.

levels.title: States of Matter & Kinetic Theory
levels.description: Solids, liquids, gases, intermolecular space, intermolecular attraction, and brownian motion.
subtopics: Comparison of solids, liquids, and gases

levels.title: Elements, Compounds & Separation
levels.description: Classification of pure substances, characteristics of compounds vs mixtures, and separation techniques.

levels.title: Chapter 4 Review & Composition of Matter
levels.description: Comprehensive review of matter, kinetic postulates, and purification.

chapters.title: Atomic Structure and Chemical Bonding
chapters.description: Subatomic particles, atomic number (Z), mass number (A), electronic configuration, isotopes, electrovalent and covalent bonding.

levels.title: Subatomic Particles & Atomic Models
levels.description: Protons, neutrons, electrons, Thomson and Rutherford atomic models, and Bohr-Bury electronic scheme.

levels.title: Atomic Number, Mass Number & Isotopes
levels.description: Calculation of protons, neutrons, and electrons, isotopes and isobars.

levels.title: Electrovalent & Covalent Bonding
levels.description: Octet rule, transfer of electrons (ionic bond in NaCl, MgCl2, CaO) and sharing of electrons (covalent in H2, Cl2, O2, N2, H2O, CH4).

levels.title: Chapter 5 Review & Bonding Mastery
levels.description: Review of atomic structure, electron configurations, and chemical bond representations.

chapters.title: Cell: The Unit of Life
chapters.description: Discovery of cell, cell theory, plant vs animal cells, ultrastructure and functions of organelles.

levels.title: Cell Theory & Structure
levels.description: Robert Hooke, Schleiden & Schwann cell theory, prokaryotic vs eukaryotic cells.
subtopics: Plant cell vs Animal cell differences

levels.title: Cell Organelles & Functions
levels.description: Nucleus, mitochondria, endoplasmic reticulum, golgi apparatus, ribosomes, lysosomes, plastids, and vacuoles.

levels.title: Chapter 6 Review & Cytology Mastery
levels.description: Review of cell biology, diagrams, and organelle functions.

chapters.title: Plant and Animal Tissues
chapters.description: Meristematic and permanent plant tissues, epithelial, connective, muscular, and nervous animal tissues.

levels.title: Plant Tissues (Meristematic & Permanent)
levels.description: Apical, lateral, intercalary meristems, parenchyma, collenchyma, sclerenchyma, and vascular tissues (xylem and phloem).

levels.title: Animal Tissues (Epithelial to Nervous)
levels.description: Squamous, cuboidal, columnar epithelial tissues, bone, cartilage, blood, striated, unstriated, cardiac muscles, and neurons.
subtopics: Connective tissue (Blood, Bone, Cartilage, Ligament, Tendon)

levels.title: Chapter 7 Review & Histology Challenge
levels.description: Comprehensive review of tissue classification, functions, and identification.
